description: Add a concise endgame HUD and Info / Cargo presentation for the Motherlode extraction-return phase and successful depot return, so the game gives a satisfying, unambiguous finale instead of only transient toast text.
steps: Use and consult miner-daily-task-runner before implementing; run ./init.sh before development, preserve the React-before-runtime startup order, and retain existing DOM IDs/classes consumed by src/dom.ts and src/game.ts.

Build on the persistent extraction phase from the preceding systems task. Inspect src/objective.ts, src/ui.tsx, src/dom.ts, src/game.ts HUD lifecycle, src/styles.css responsive HUD/modal rules, src/stats.ts, and current UI tests. Extract DOM-free formatter(s) for compact pending-extraction and completed-expedition copy instead of embedding state decisions in DOM mutation code.

Add stable React/runtime hooks that make the post-core objective clear while underground and show a modest completion summary at the depot, including the Motherlode reward/career outcome and an understandable next action; keep normal pre-core objective/scanner/fuel/cargo/service guidance readable and unchanged.

Style the presentation for desktop and a 390×844 phone viewport without obscuring meters, controls, or modal navigation. Verify Info / Cargo covers underlying HUD visually, focus returns to the game on close, and keyboard/touch movement still resumes.

Add formatter and React shell/runtime hook tests. Run ./init.sh and desktop/phone CDP smokes that enter the extraction-return phase, inspect the HUD and Info / Cargo copy, finish at the depot, verify the completion presentation, resume input after closing the modal, and collect runtime exceptions.
acceptance: After a core claim, players can immediately tell that the remaining objective is to extract safely to the depot; after returning, they see a durable, readable completion summary rather than relying on a short-lived toast.

The presentation is accurate across live movement, HUD refresh, save/load, reset/game-over as defined by the extraction system, desktop and phone layouts, and does not regress existing HUD guidance, modal layering, or controls.
DOM-free formatter, React/runtime hook coverage, and desktop/phone browser smokes pass with no runtime exceptions.
Before marking complete, follow miner-daily-task-runner and run ./init.sh, ./test.sh, npm test, npm run typecheck, and npm run build as fresh final verification.
